title: Plan Review Findings
description: Structured output schema for plan review sub-agents

reviewer.description: Persona name that produced this output (e.g., 'prd-reviewer', 'coherence-reviewer', 'skeptic-reviewer')

findings.description: List of plan review findings. Empty array if no issues found.

title.description: Short, specific issue title. 10 words or fewer.

section.description: Document section where the issue lives (e.g., 'Requirements', 'Architecture', 'Scope')

line.description: Primary line number of the issue

why_it_matters.description: Impact — not 'what is wrong' but 'what goes wrong if not addressed'

suggestion.description: Concrete rewording or structural fix. Omit or null if no good suggestion is obvious — a bad suggestion is worse than none.

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence in this finding, calibrated per persona

evidence.description: Document-grounded evidence: quoted text, section references, or pattern descriptions. At least 1 item.

residual_concerns.description: Concerns the reviewer noticed but could not confirm as findings (below confidence threshold or too speculative)

confidence_thresholds.suppress: Below 0.50 — do not report. Finding is speculative.
confidence_thresholds.flag: 0.50–0.69 — include but low confidence. Per-persona calibration applies.

priority_definitions.HIGH: Blocks execution; cannot start the next step without resolving. Someone will be blocked or confused.
priority_definitions.MEDIUM: Creates risk; work can start but likely leads to rework or confusion. Should fix.
priority_definitions.LOW: Improvement opportunity; plan works but could be clearer or tighter. Author's discretion.
